transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I’ve been… losing my temper a lot. Snapping at people over small things—work calls, at home too. That’s not really how I usually am, so… I figured I should talk to someone.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood besides feeling irritable—like feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… kind of. I wouldn’t say sad exactly. It’s more like… I’m just not feeling things.

My wife will make dinner, or my kids are talking about soccer like they always do, and I know I should feel happy to be there. But it’s just… blank. Like nothing in me responds.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family?
Yeah… I guess so. I’m there with my wife and kids, and I know I should feel glad, but… it’s like nothing really comes up. I just feel kind of blank.
Do you feel this way most of the day, even when nothing stressful is happening?

Yeah… most of the day, I think. Even when things are normal at home. My wife’ll make dinner, or the kids are talking about soccer, and I know I should feel glad to be there, but… there’s just nothing there.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy, even when you haven't done anything physically or mentally exhausting?
I don’t know… not really something I’ve paid attention to. I’m tired some, I guess, but I can’t tell if it’s that or just… everything else.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating more or less than usual or losing or gaining weight without trying?
I haven’t really noticed. I mean… I’m eating, I guess. I don’t know about weight. I haven’t been checking.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past couple of weeks?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. I’ve been… low, I guess, a lot. Most days. But I’m not really keeping track of it like that.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
I’m not sure. I’ve felt low a lot, yeah, but saying it’s been most of the day every day for two weeks… I don’t really know.
Can you think back over the past few weeks—was there a time when you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks or more in a row?
I don’t really know. I can’t say for sure it was two weeks straight like that. It’s been on and off… or maybe just hard to tell.
Looking back, was there ever a time when you felt this low or down for at least two weeks straight without a break?
I… I can’t really say that. It’s been bad at times, but I don’t know if it was two weeks straight with no break.
Looking back, has there ever been a period where you felt low or down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks without a significant break in between?
I don’t know. I can’t really pin it down like that… two weeks, most of the day. It’s been rough, but I’m not sure about that specific kind of stretch.
Looking back, was there ever a time when you felt this low or down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row without feeling any significant relief during that time?
I’m not sure. I know I’ve felt pretty low, but I can’t honestly say it was like that every day for two full weeks with no real relief.
Have you found that things that used to bring you pleasure, like time with your family or activities you used to enjoy, don’t feel rewarding or meaningful to you anymore?

Yeah… I guess. Like, my wife will make dinner, or the kids are talking about soccer, and I know I should feel happy being there. But it’s just… there’s nothing there. Like I can’t really respond to it.
Have you stopped finding pleasure or enjoyment in activities that you used to like, such as spending time with your family or any hobbies you may have had?
Yeah… I mean, it’s like I said. My wife makes dinner, the kids talk about soccer, normal stuff… and I know I should feel something. But I just don’t. It’s like nothing in me responds.
Have you stopped finding pleasure or enjoyment in activities or hobbies that you used to like, even things that weren’t related to your family?
Yeah… I guess so. I know I keep talking about my wife and kids, but even with normal stuff, things I should enjoy, it’s like I just can’t feel much from it. Like something in me doesn’t respond.
Looking back, has there ever been a time when you felt this way—low or down—most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks straight without any significant relief during that time?
I don’t know… not really sure. I’ve had rough stretches, yeah, but I can’t say it was like that for two weeks straight with no break.
Can you think of any activity—like a hobby, sport, or something you used to do just for fun—that used to feel good or meaningful to you, but now feels empty or doesn’t bring you any real feeling?

Yeah… I mean, not really a hobby, I guess. It’s more just being at home. My wife makes dinner, the kids talk about soccer, and I know I should feel glad to be there… but I just don’t. It’s like nothing in me answers.
Looking back, was there ever a time when you felt low or down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks straight without any significant relief during that time?
I… I don’t really know. I’ve had bad periods, sure, but I can’t say it was like that every day for two weeks straight. I’m not sure.
Can you think of any specific activity or moment in the past few weeks where you felt genuine pleasure or interest in something, even for a short time?
Not really. I mean… I’m there at dinner, my wife cooks, the kids are talking about soccer and all that, and I know I should feel something. Glad, I guess. But it’s just… nothing really comes up.
